title: Active Profile ID Fallback
outcome_summary: Active profile canonicalization was implemented so that a stale `ActiveProfileId` in persisted configuration is repaired to `default` during startup and profile refresh before any reference-path-dependent operation runs. An initial implementation by the Plan Auditor agent was verified, two issues were found (an out-of-plan normalization call inside `FileService` and missing `ViewModelInitializerTests`), and both were corrected.
project_summary: This project fixes a runtime crash that occurs when the persisted ActiveProfileId in application configuration refers to a profile that no longer exists. It introduces a centralized NormalizeActiveProfileAsync method in ProfileService that detects stale profile IDs and falls back to the default profile during startup and profile refresh, before any reference-path-dependent file operations execute. Regression tests were added to cover stale-ID startup and refresh scenarios, and manifest documentation was updated to reflect the new canonicalization invariant.
